questions.question: What is the formula for calculating Price Elasticity of Demand (PED)?
questions.expected_answer: PED = % Δ Qd / % Δ P (Percentage change in Quantity Demanded divided by Percentage change in Price)

questions.question: If your calculated PED is less than 1, how do you classify the elasticity?
In the example problem, what was the percentage change in quantity demanded when it fell from 100 to 80 units?
What does Unitary Elasticity mean in terms of percentages?
questions.expected_answer: It means the percentage change in quantity demanded is exactly equal to the percentage change in price.
